STAGE 1 (reading the code). Goal: verify behaviour x geometry fidelity, trainability, integration for candidate poincare-frechet-successor-codebook. Read: full tree listing (only 4 py files: model/frechet_poincare.py 207 lines, model/layers.py 342, model/model.py 94, train_rqvae.py 594, model/__init__.py 6). Observed: frechet_poincare.py implements mobius_add/exp_0/exp_at/log_at/log_0/poincare_distance and class FrechetCodebook(accumulate/apply). layers.py VQLayer.forward takes the curved branch when frechet is not None and item_ids is not None: point=exp_0(latent), weights=frechet.weight_of(item_ids), cost=frechet.distances(point, codebook), argmin, remember(); quant_loss = beta*(weights*commitment).mean() + mse(x, x_q.detach()); x_q = log_0(code). train_rqvae.py builds successor attraction (indegree+1)/(interactions+2), clipped [0.25,4], mean-normalised over active items, binds it to every level, calls frechet_step_sums() + all_reduce + apply_frechet_codebook_step() after optimizer.step(), drops embed.weight.grad. Open: (i) I found what looks like a sign error in mobius_add (y-term is subtracted) and a normalisation error in exp_at (uses v/|v| where exp_0 uses v), so exp_at(log_at(c,y)) != y; verifying numerically by hand; (ii) need repo-level conventions to judge integration (only the tree is readable; repo root glob is permission-denied).

FINAL VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX.
(a) PASS: one connected pathway. train_rqvae.py:256-299 builds (indeg+1)/(n+2) from train only; :328-332 binds it to every level; layers.py:140-149 curved branch (point=exp_0, weights=weight_of, cost=distances, argmin, remember); layers.py:161-170 weighted curved commitment; frechet_poincare.py:149-176 weighted log_at tangent sums; model.py:61-80 + train_rqvae.py:440-448 all_reduce then exp_at move into embed.weight. Switches USE_BEHAVIOUR/USE_GEOMETRY exist (train_rqvae.py:101-102, layers.py:72-76, frechet_poincare.py:128-147).
(b) NEEDS_FIX, two blocking defects in model/frechet_poincare.py. 1) exp_at at 58-60 multiplies tanh(c*norm/2)/(c*norm) by direction=v/norm, dropping a factor norm: step length becomes tanh(norm/2)/norm, tending to 0.5 for small tangents, so the Frechet step never shrinks and slots are pinned at the clamp 1-1e-4. Repro c=1, base 0.1, y 0.2: displacement 0.436 instead of 0.1; exp_at(0.1,v) vs exp_0(v) with norm(v)=0.01 gives 0.5 vs 0.005. Fix: multiply by v, not direction. 2) mobius_add at line 31 subtracts (1-c*x2)*y instead of adding: mobius_add(0,y)=-y, so exp_at(0.5,log_at(0.5,0.1))=1.642 clipped to 0.9999 instead of 0.1, and poincare_distance (86-88) is not the Poincare distance. Fix: change the sign. Minor: train_rqvae.py:278-286 counts n_v per sliding-window row, deflating weights for popular items; count distinct (user,item).
(c) PASS: entry point train_rqvae.py:592-594; frozen paths 61-67; own arm dir 59; valid SID export + collision extension 544-551; DDP reduce 440-448; single-card branch SINGLE_GPU_ENV=GENREC_SINGLE_GPU at 73 and 563-567. Non-blocking note: ARM_NAME (58) is TIGER_<tree>, not the bare tree name; unverifiable from this sandbox.

Stage record 1: goal = read the candidate tree and locate the mechanism. Read model/frechet_poincare.py (205 lines), model/layers.py (358), model/model.py (94), train_rqvae.py (599). Observed: FrechetCodebook implements mobius_add/clamp_ball/exp_0/exp_at/log_at/poincare_distance; VQLayer.forward takes a curved branch when self.frechet is not None and item_ids is not None, computes point=clamp_ball(exp_0(latent)), weights=frechet.weight_of(item_ids), assignment via frechet.distances, commitment via frechet.commitment weighted by the same weights; trainer computes _build_successor_attraction from train parquet and calls frechet_step_sums/apply_frechet_codebook_step after optimizer.step. Open: whether _repository_root resolves correctly, whether baseline comparison holds, DDP/launcher details, numerical hazards, and whether the weight table indexing is right.

Stage record 2 (checks a/b/c). (a) Coupling: layers.py:148-157 selects the curved branch when frechet!=None and item_ids given, builds point=clamp_ball(exp_0(latent)) and weights=frechet.weight_of(item_ids); assignment cost frechet.distances -> poincare_distance (frechet_poincare.py:143-151); commitment at layers.py:176-177 uses poincare_distance(point, code.detach())**2 weighted by the same weights -> quant_loss -> backward into the encoder; weights bound at train_rqvae.py:329-333 from _build_successor_attraction (256-300, train parquet only) and the codebook moved at train_rqvae.py:445-453 via frechet.accumulate/log_at (frechet_poincare.py:159-180) + apply/exp_at (182-199). One connected pathway, both switches inside it (use_behaviour -> ones at 138-141; use_curvature -> Euclidean branches at 145-150, 155-157, 174-177, 193-196). No OT/fork/cone; exp_0/log_at/exp_at/poincare_distance are Mobius-based and mutually consistent inverses. (b) Gradient reaches encoder through clamp_ball/exp_0/poincare_distance in the commitment; codebook is deliberately frozen (embed.weight.requires_grad_(False), layers.py:84) so DDP has no unused params; codebook loss in the curved branch is F.mse_loss(x, x_q.detach()) at layers.py:178 -> a constant with zero gradient (dead term, minor). Also init_codebook (layers.py:198-201) queries the ball codebook with the raw tangent residual x instead of exp_0(x) -> geometry mismatch at init only. No inf/nan path found: clamp_ball(1e-4), atanh clamped at 1-1e-7, denominators clamp_min, finite-guard in apply. (c) FOUND BLOCKING: _repository_root (train_rqvae.py:42-59) matches the FIRST ancestor p with (p/'stage2_RQ-VAE').is_dir(); because results/stage2_RQ-VAE exists, the match happens at REPO_ROOT/results, not the repo root, so REPO_ROOT=R/results and every path becomes R/results/results/... (TRAIN_FILE, RESULT_DIR) and R/results/stage1_GeneEmbedding/... (EMBEDDING_FILE) -> load_embeddings raises at train_rqvae.py:317 before training. Same for both the tree location and the promoted results/stage2_RQ-VAE/<arm>/ location. Launcher single-card branch (SINGLE_GPU_ENV='GENREC_SINGLE_GPU', line 73, 568-572) is present and correct; DDP Fréchet all_reduce at 448-452 is symmetric across ranks; SID export indexes tokens by embedding row and _extend_collisions enforces uniqueness.

FINAL ANSWER. VERDICT: NEEDS_FIX. (a) PASS (curve x successor weights in one path: layers.py:148-157/176-178 + frechet_poincare.py:159-199 + train_rqvae.py:329-333/445-453). (b) PASS with one minor finding: dead constant term F.mse_loss(x, x_q.detach()) at layers.py:178 has zero gradient (codebook-side loss kept after the codebook was frozen); the encoder gradient path through the weighted curved commitment is real and the switches change distance, commitment and codebook step. (c) NEEDS_FIX, blocking: _repository_root at train_rqvae.py:42-53 resolves the first ancestor containing a 'stage2_RQ-VAE' child, which is REPO_ROOT/results (because results/stage2_RQ-VAE exists), so REPO_ROOT=R/results and EMBEDDING_FILE/RESULT_DIR become R/results/stage1_GeneEmbedding/... and R/results/results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_poincare-frechet-successor-codebook/ -> FileNotFoundError at train_rqvae.py:317 and outputs outside the mandated results/stage2_RQ-VAE/<promoted name>/; correction: use the marker (p/'stage2_RQ-VAE').is_dir() and p/'results', i.e. return the parent whose 'results/stage2_RQ-VAE' is a directory, and drop the extra 'results' join. No claim made about the TIGER_ arm-name prefix because it is the framework's naming, not verifiable here.

OBSERVED (a) coupling: train_rqvae.py:107-108 switches USE_BEHAVIOUR/USE_GEOMETRY -> _tokenizer_config:248-258 (frechet_codebook=True, use_behaviour, use_curvature) -> layers.py:73-77 FrechetCodebook -> layers.py:148-157 curved forward: point=clamp_ball(exp_0(latent)), weights=self.frechet.weight_of(item_ids), cost=self.frechet.distances(point, codebook) (poincare_distance), argmin -> commitment at layers.py:176-177 beta*(weights*commitment).mean() (curved d^2, code detached) + encoder gradient -> frechet_poincare.py:159-180 accumulate: tangent=log_at(codebook[index],point) scatter-added with the SAME weights -> train_rqvae.py:448-459 all_reduce + model.py:65-80 apply_frechet_codebook_step -> frechet_poincare.py:182-199 exp_at(codebook, eta*mean tangent) written into embed.weight. So behaviour weights and curvature meet in one path: weight -> log at c -> mean -> exp at c -> codebook -> SID. Removing behaviour (weight_of returns ones, frechet_poincare.py:138-139) or replacing the curve (distances/commitment/accumulate/apply Euclidean branches 143-157,174-177,193-196) changes the codebook and hence the SID.

No dead term found in the mechanism (weights used both in the commitment and in accumulate).
OBSERVED (c) integration: entry point train_rqvae.py:603-605 -> _launch_via_torchrun (570-600) reads SINGLE_GPU_ENV="GENREC_SINGLE_GPU" (line 79) and returns for the single-card branch; 4-card path delegates to tools.research.stage2.launcher with contract port; RESULT_DIR=REPO_ROOT/results/stage2_RQ-VAE/TIGER_poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (lines 62-73), SID export item_sids.json + sids_for_hgrec.npy keyed by enumerate item id (555-562), training-only behaviour from results/stage0_build_parquet/train.parquet, embeddings from stage1_GeneEmbedding/output/sentence_t5.npy.

Read model/frechet_poincare.py, model/layers.py, model/model.py, train_rqvae.py, tests/test_codebook_step.py. Findings:
(1) Behaviour boundary/pathway OK: weights from TRAIN_FILE only (train_rqvae.py:262-306, built once at 335, bound to every level 336-339); weight_of -> FrechetCodebook.weight_of (frechet_poincare.py:131-141) feeds BOTH the commitment quant_loss (layers.py:176-178) and the weighted tangent accumulate/apply (frechet_poincare.py:159-199 via model/model.py:40-80, called in the train loop train_rqvae.py:451-459). Assignment argmin of poincare_distance (layers.py:155-156) is decided by the moved codebook, so removing behaviour or curvature changes the SID. Switches are real: behaviour-off -> ones; curvature-off -> squared Euclidean distances/commitment and Euclidean tangent step, still the same estimator.
(2) Defect (minor, init only): layers.py:194-201 VQLayer.init_codebook passes the raw latent x to frechet.distances while training/export pass clamp_ball(exp_0(x)) (layers.py:153). Points outside the ball give a non-positive Mobius denominator / saturated distances, so the level-1 assignment used to build the residual for levels 2-3 is the argmin of a different geometry than the one training uses. One-time init; does not affect training/export assignment or the coupling.
(3) Defect (minor): layers.py:178 F.mse_loss(x, x_q.detach()) is a constant with zero gradient; the codebook loss of the baseline is silently disabled (intended, since the codebook is estimator-only) but the term still enters quant_loss and the logged loss.
(4) SID export: train_rqvae.py:548-561 get_indices over arange(len(embeddings)) with the same curved argmin, only rank 0 after all_reduce of the step sums (451-459); _extend_collisions (214-227) appends a deterministic per-(group,item_id) token 768+occurrence and asserts global uniqueness (556). No per-user or per-request path; cannot differ per rank because the codebook step is all_reduced and applied identically.
